items.summary: Most retirees drain their savings slowly and hope the money outlasts them, but a growing number of octogenarians never spend a single share and still clear six figures a year. The three-tier strategy behind that math is simpler than it sounds, and the tradeoffs between tiers are where most people go wrong.
